method: Runtime assets only. Identical semantic feature profiles, exports and primary-key-index setting. Baseline retains all core function/statement/query implementations and all functions within enabled semantic features; selected runtime infers the complete schema/query closure, including JSON families, subtype, CTE, recursion, JOIN and compound SELECT. Oxc minified ESM, release Wasm GC; Brotli quality 11 per asset with round trip. Excludes host, IndexedDB wrappers, catalog data and compiler. Native typed results verified for baseline/selected JS/Wasm on every fixture. Not an additive app-download estimate or a speed measurement.
